page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet. Logo and title block at top, the e-rara.ch notices and terms of use below. No printed text of the book.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch, Universitätsbibliothek Basel), not a page of the printed book. It shows the e-rara logo, the title "Selectorum carminum ex doctiss. poetis collectorum, et nunc primùm in lucem editiorum libri quatuor", the author "Stoer, Jacob", the place and date "[Genève], 1590", the persistent link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-1262, multilingual terms-of-use notices and the Visual Library logo. Left out as digitiser's matter. The book's own title page is not on this scan.
